jsonld_diff.before: Download free dot to dot printables as PDF. Easy to extreme difficulty puzzles for all ages — animals, nature, fantasy and more.
jsonld_diff.after: Browse dot-to-dot catalog entries. Open a card to check the preview and available downloads; adult reference artwork is not a verified numbered worksheet.

jsonld_diff.before: Yes. Every puzzle in this collection is completely free to download and print, with no watermarks and no sign-up required. Simply click the puzzle you want and download the PDF.
jsonld_diff.after: Static worksheet PDF downloads do not require an account. Open a card to view its downloads. PDFs are generated in your browser and include a website credit. AI image generation is separate and requires sign-in and available credits.

jsonld_diff.before: All PDFs are designed to print on both A4 (210 × 297 mm) and US Letter (8.5 × 11 in). Select 'Fit to page' in your print dialog to ensure the puzzle fills the sheet correctly without cropping.
jsonld_diff.after: The detail-page PDF export uses A4 portrait. Check the preview before printing. US Letter output has not been verified; do not assume every worksheet fits without cropping.

jsonld_diff.before: Yes — use the generator further down this page. Upload any image (a pet, portrait, or simple drawing), choose how many dots you want, and the tool converts it into a numbered dot-to-dot puzzle you can download as PDF. No design experience needed.
jsonld_diff.after: Use the homepage image-upload flow to make a puzzle from your own image. A simple drawing with a clear outline is a useful starting point; review the result before printing. AI image generation requires sign-in and available credits.

jsonld_diff.before: Absolutely. Hard and Extreme puzzles with 100–200+ dots provide a focused, meditative activity for adults. Many people find them a useful screen-free wind-down activity. The custom generator also lets adults create puzzles from their own meaningful photos.
jsonld_diff.after: Numbered dot-to-dot activities can offer a focused, screen-free break. The Mountain and Mandala entries here are reference artwork, not verified high-dot-count numbered worksheets. A playable adult worksheet and matching solution have not been confirmed for those entries.

jsonld_diff.before: Pick any puzzle from the collection below and click Download. The file opens print-ready at A4 or US Letter size.
jsonld_diff.after: Open a card to view worksheet details. Download PDF creates an A4 PDF from the Puzzle image; Download PNG exports the Solution image. These are different resources. Check availability before printing.

jsonld_diff.before: Upload any photo and generate a custom numbered dot-to-dot puzzle with adjustable difficulty, downloadable as PDF.
jsonld_diff.after: Use the homepage image-upload flow to make and review a numbered puzzle. AI image generation requires sign-in and available credits; results vary by image.

jsonld_diff.before: A connect the dots puzzle for adults uses the same numbered-dot format as children's worksheets, but at much higher detail — typically 100 to 300+ dots instead of 10–50. The extra density creates finer, more realistic outlines (portraits, architecture, detailed animals) and takes considerably longer to complete, which is part of the appeal for adult users.
jsonld_diff.after: Adult dot-to-dot worksheets use numbered dots to build an outline. Difficulty depends on the actual sequence and readability; a title or difficulty label alone does not establish the number of dots or that a worksheet is ready to solve.

jsonld_diff.before: Yes. Every puzzle featured on this page is free to download as a PDF, with no watermark and no account required. The custom generator further down this page also includes free credits — no payment is needed to try it.
jsonld_diff.after: Static detail-page PDF downloads do not require an account and include a website credit. The current Mountain and Mandala entries are reference artwork, not verified numbered worksheets. AI image generation requires sign-in and available credits.

jsonld_diff.before: Hard puzzles on this site range from 60–100 dots, and Extreme puzzles range from 100–300+ dots. For comparison, a typical children's worksheet has 10–25 dots. Higher dot counts mean finer detail and a longer, more absorbing completion time.
jsonld_diff.after: The dot counts of the current Mountain and Mandala entries have not been verified. Their catalog ranges must not be treated as confirmed counts of numbered dots. No playable 100+ dot adult worksheet is confirmed here.

jsonld_diff.after: Use the homepage upload flow to make a puzzle from your own image. Review the numbered result before printing; a clear outline is a useful starting point. A playable extreme puzzle from every photo is not guaranteed. AI image generation is separate and requires sign-in and available credits.
